title: CSCI 472 — Historical & Current Perspectives in Computer Science
subject: Computing Practice and Research
description: An independent, catalog-aligned learning companion. It is not an official RIT course section or a replacement for the instructor's syllabus.
outcomes: Define the core ethical principles guiding computing professionals and their societal impact.
Explain how responsible technical communication ensures research integrity and accurate reporting.
Analyze how historical milestones and past issues shape modern computer science design and decision-making.
